en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard image showing a street view in a European town. The main building is a grand structure labeled 'Kaiserliches Postamt' (Imperial Post Office) with ornate architectural details, surrounded by other similar period buildings. There are several people walking on the street, and visible power lines and trees line the road. The text at the bottom identifies the location as Flöha and references 'König Albertstrasse.'
